preconditions.description: The number of operations q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= di < i for i in range(1, q) for operation in operations if operation[0] == 'undo' for di in [int(operation[1])])
preconditions.description: For each undo operation, the number of days di to undo is between 0 and i-1 inclusive, where i is the current operation index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 for operation in operations if operation[0] == 'set' for xi in [int(operation[2])])
preconditions.description: For each set operation, the priority xi is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(ai) <= 15 for operation in operations for ai in operation[1:] if isinstance(ai, str))
preconditions.description: All assignment names ai have a length between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(ai.islower() for operation in operations for ai in operation[1:] if isinstance(ai, str))
preconditions.description: All assignment names ai consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if ai not in assignments else sum(1 for priority in assignments.values() if priority < assignments[ai])
postconditions.description: For a query operation, the output is the number of assignments with a priority lower than the priority of assignment ai, or -1 if ai is not in the to-do list.
